chunks.sanskrit: yatsatyaṃ tu mayā kṛtaṃ mama vibho kṛtyaṃ tu nātaḥ paraṃ yanmanmānamaiśapādakamale bhaktyā mayaivārpitam | sarvasvamata evametaditarannāsyeva jānāmyatastyaktvā kṣipramanāthanātha karuṇāsindho prasanno bhava
chunks.l1:
## pan-p01 (1)
what-was-done-by-me-in-truth / indeed / by-me / done / my / O-Lord / duty / indeed / not / beyond-this / higher / which / my-pride / on-the-Lord's-lotus-feet / with-devotion / by-me / indeed / offered / my-all / therefore / indeed / this / other / not / exists / indeed / I-know / therefore / having-abandoned / quickly / O-protector-of-the-helpless / O-ocean-of-compassion / pleased / be // pan-p01
chunks.l2: Whatever I have truly done, O Lord — no duty of mine goes beyond this: my pride, laid at Your lotus feet with devotion. This is my all; I know there is nothing other. So, casting all else aside — quickly, O protector of the helpless, O ocean of compassion — be pleased with me!
chunks.c1:
## pan-p01 — C1

**SUMMARY.** The whole duty is one act: pride offered on the Lord's feet; all else denied, and only immediate pleasure asked.

*Rasa: śṛṅgāra/bhakti (devotion as love-in-separation from the Lord) — The sthāyibhāva is devotion (bhakti) expressed as total offering (sarvasva); helplessness (anātha) is vyabhicāri, integrated into the plea for pleasure (prasāda).*
chunks.argmap:
## pan-p01 — argument map

What is true of my doing = one duty = offering of pride. My all = this offering; anything other does not exist, for me. Renunciation already accomplished (tyaktvā) grounds the plea: be pleased.

### Open
- Whether prasāda means 'pleasure' or 'grace' is unresolved.

chunks.sanskrit: maheśa tvaddvāri sphuratu rucirā vāgatitarāṃ mamaiṣā nirdoṣaṃ jaya jaya maheśeti satatam | śivā saiṣā vāṇī bhavatu śivadā mahyamaniśaṃ maheśanāthaṃ māṃ śaraṇada sanāthaṃ kuru vibho
chunks.l1:
## pan-p02 (2)
O-Maheśa / at-Your-door / let-flash-forth / charming / speech / exceedingly / my / this / faultless / victory / victory / O-Maheśa / thus / constantly / auspicious / that / this / speech / let-it-be / bliss-bestowing / for-me / unceasingly / having-Maheśa-as-protector / me / O-giver-of-refuge / possessed-of-a-protector / make / O-Lord // pan-p02
chunks.l2: O Maheśa, at Your door let this charming speech of mine flash forth, exceeding all: 'Victory, victory to Maheśa!' — faultless, unceasing. Let this very speech, auspicious, be bliss-giving to me forever. O Lord, O giver of refuge, make me — whose protector is Maheśa — possessed of a protector!
chunks.c1:
## pan-p02 — C1

**SUMMARY.** Speech becomes the offering: the word crying victory at the threshold is itself to become bliss-giving; having Maheśa as protector is to become being protected.

*Rasa: bhakti (devotional praise) — The sthāyibhāva is devotion expressed as praise (jaya); the threshold (dvāra) is vibhāva, speech (vāk) is the offering. No sorrow of absence; rasa is joy of praise.*
chunks.argmap:
## pan-p02 — argument map

Praise at the door is the offering. The cry 'jaya jaya maheśa' is both act and instrument. Status (sanātha) turns into request (make possessed of a protector).

### Open
- Whether śivadā means 'bliss-bestowing' or 'Śiva-giving' is unresolved.

chunks.sanskrit: brūṣe nottamāṅga paśyasi na māmetādṛśaṃ duḥkhitaṃ vijñaptiṃ bahudhā kṛtāṃ na śṛṇuṣe nāyāsi manmānase | saṃsārārṇavagartamadhyapatitaṃ prāyeṇa nālambase vākcakṣuḥśravaṇāṅghriṇādirahitaṃ tvāmāha satyaṃ śrutiḥ
chunks.l1:
## pan-p03 (3)
You-speak / not / O-best-limbed-one / You-see / not / me / such / suffering / entreaty / in-many-ways / made / not / You-listen / not / You-come / into-my-mind / fallen-into-the-pit-amid-the-ocean-of-transmigration / mostly / not / You-support / devoid-of-speech-sight-hearing-feet-and-the-like / You / declares / truly / scripture // pan-p03
chunks.l2: You speak not, O best-limbed one; You look not upon me, wretched as I am. My entreaty, made in many ways, You hear not; You come not into my mind. Fallen into the pit amid transmigration's ocean, I am mostly left unsupported — yet scripture truly declares You devoid of speech, sight, hearing, feet and the like!
chunks.c1:
## pan-p03 — C1

**SUMMARY.** Five refusals charged — speak, see, hear, come, support — and scripture converts the charge into doctrine: the Lord is sense-free.

*Rasa: karuṇa (compassion-plea) shaded by adbhuta (wonder at doctrine) — The sthāyibhāva is devotion (bhakti) in the mode of complaint (vijñapti); the vyabhicāri is despair (duḥkha), integrated by the turn to śruti's declaration of sense-freedom.*
chunks.argmap:
## pan-p03 — argument map

Five refusals charged: speak, see, hear, come, support. Scripture converts the charge into doctrine: the Lord is sense-free. prāyeṇa softens the unsupported claim.

### Open
- Whether the turn to śruti is sincere resolution or ironic resignation is unresolved.

chunks.sanskrit: gurorvākyādyukti-pracaya-racana-unmārjana-vaśātsamāśvāsācchāstraṃ prati samucitādapi kathitam | vilīne śaṅkābhre hṛdayagaganodbhāsimahasaḥ prabhoḥ sūryasyeva spṛśatu caraṇān dhvāntajayinaḥ
chunks.l1:
## pan-p04 (4)
of-the-guru / from-the-word / by-force-of-wiping-away-the-fabric-of-piled-up-reasonings / from-assurance / scripture / regarding / from-what-is-fitting / even / told / when-dissolved / the-cloud-of-doubt / whose-splendor-shines-in-the-heart-sky / of-the-Lord / of-the-sun / like / let-touch / the-feet / of-the-darkness-conquering-one // pan-p04
chunks.l2: From the guru's word — by the force that wipes away the fabric of heaped-up reasonings — and from the assurance told, fittingly, out of regard for scripture: when the cloud of doubt has dissolved, let me touch the feet of the Lord, whose splendor shines in the sky of the heart — like the sun, the conqueror of darkness.
chunks.c1:
## pan-p04 — C1

**SUMMARY.** Against the silence stand two testimonies — the guru's word and fitting scriptural assurance — whose force wipes away piled-up reasonings; with doubt dissolved, the feet of the heart-sky Lord.

*Rasa: śānta (tranquility) with adbhuta (wonder) — The sthāyibhāva is devotion (bhakti) in the mode of assurance (samāśvāsa); the vyabhicāri is doubt (śaṅkā), dissolved (vilīna) into the touch of feet.*
chunks.argmap:
## pan-p04 — argument map

Two testimonies: guru's word and fitting scriptural assurance. Their force wipes away (not refutes) heaped reasonings. Doubt-cloud dissolved, touch the feet of the heart-sky Lord.

### Open
- Whether guru's word and scripture are two distinct sources or one twofold source is unresolved.

chunks.sanskrit: yātastvatsahavāsato bahutaraḥ kālo vatāsmin kṣaṇe kiṃ kiṃ vā na kṛtaṃ tvayā varagurūpāsānimittena me | vāraṃ vāramahaṃ punarnirupamāṃ divyaṃ bhuvaṃ prāsuvatkāyastvāṃ kila vismarāmi yadataḥ stheyaṃ na bhūyastvayā
chunks.l1:
## pan-p05 (5)
gone / from-dwelling-with-You / very-long / time / alas / in-this / moment / what / what / or / not / done / by-You / for-the-sake-of-serving-the-excellent-guru / for-me / time / after-time / I / again / incomparable / divine / plane / whose-body-has-attained-it / You / indeed / I-forget / since / therefore / to-be-remained / not / further / by-You // pan-p05
chunks.l2: Much time dwelling with You has passed — alas, in this very moment! What, what has not been done by You for me, for the sake of serving the excellent guru! Again and again I, whose body has attained the incomparable divine plane — yet indeed I forget You. Therefore, by You, let there be no further staying-away!
chunks.c1:
## pan-p05 — C1

**SUMMARY.** Long dwelling-with and total grace received, yet repeated forgetting; the only request is no more absence.

*Rasa: karuṇa (compassion-plea) with śānta (tranquility of acceptance) — The sthāyibhāva is devotion (bhakti) in the mode of confession (vismara admitted); the vyabhicāri is forgetting, integrated into the plea for presence (stheyaṃ na bhūyas).*
chunks.argmap:
## pan-p05 — argument map

Long dwelling-with and total grace received. Repeated forgetting admitted (kila). Therefore no further staying-away requested.

### Open
- prāsuvatkāyaḥ is obscure; glossed 'whose body has attained it'.
